name: Quernjaw
lore: It ground for a household that is not there. It goes on turning and it is not particular about what goes in.
prompt: Pair of round grinding quern stones set one on the other and standing on a squat base, the upper stone turning slowly against the lower like a jaw, a broken wooden handle stub in its rim, fine white grain dust caught in the cut grooves
